thread:
marie: Heads-up — multiple customers are saying the promo code they entered returns success but no free-trial credits are added. Ticket CS-1923. Example: acme-corp.

alex: Do we have an API error/code? Or is the apply endpoint returning applied=false?

marie: Customers see 200 OK from /v1/promos/apply. Body: `{"applied": false, "reason": "limit_reached"}`. No stack traces from our side.

sam: Any chance this is the per-customer limit being hit? Which campaign is this?

marie: Campaign ID campaign_9876 — created last week. UI shows active, start/end look fine. Several customers (different accounts) all hit the same message.

zach: Quick repro I ran:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/promos/apply \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -d '{"code":"ACME-FREETRIAL","account_id":"acme-corp"}'
```
Response:
```json
{"applied": false, "reason": "limit_reached", "code_id":"code_3344"}
```

sam: Ok I pulled the promo record from the DB: `code_3344` has `global_redemptions_allowed: 100`, `per_customer_limit: 0`. That 0 stood out.

alex: per_customer_limit: 0? That's effectively "never allowed" not unlimited. Can you paste the CSV/creation flow?

sam: We imported codes via the bulk import UI. The CSV had an empty cell for per-customer limit. During import our loader coerces blank -> 0.

marie: So UI shows blank (looks unlimited) but DB has 0. Customers see limit_reached because per-customer allowed = 0. That explains why different accounts all get blocked.

alex: Oof. That CSV import edge-case has tripped us before but usually in testing. Need a quick patch: treat blank as null/unset (meaning unlimited) instead of 0.

zach: I can run a SELECT to find affected codes:
```sql
SELECT id, code, campaign_id FROM promo_codes WHERE per_customer_limit = 0 AND created_via = 'bulk_import' AND created_at >= '2026-03-01';
```
That returns ~42 codes across 3 campaigns, including code_3344.

marie: Action plan? We have live customers complaining.

alex: 1) Fix loader to avoid blank->0 2) Backfill DB for affected codes to set per_customer_limit = NULL (or 9999) depending on campaign default 3) Re-run a reapply script for customers who attempted to redeem and failed. 4) Communicate to affected customers with credits applied and apology.

sam: I pushed a quick fix to the import service: treat empty string as NULL and log a warning. Deploying to staging now.

devops-bot: deploy started: import-service v2.3.1 -> staging.

zach: While staging deploy runs I'll prepare the backfill script. Proposed SQL to set NULL for those codes in campaign_9876:
```sql
UPDATE promo_codes SET per_customer_limit = NULL WHERE campaign_id = 'campaign_9876' AND per_customer_limit = 0;
```

sam: Good. Note: some campaigns intentionally set 0 to mean "disabled" when created by API. We need to be careful to only change codes created via bulk_import and where UI showed blank. I'll add a guard on created_via.

alex: Also add a short-lived safety flag to the reapply script to avoid double-crediting. Reapply should only touch records with a failed_apply record in the attempts table.

marie: Can we run on acme-corp first and confirm credits land?

support-bot: Reapply job queued: job_7784 (targets: account=acme-corp, code=ACME-FREETRIAL).

devops-bot: staging deploy finished: import-service v2.3.1 -> staging.

sam: Deploy to prod in 10m after quick smoke. Backfill script ready and tested on staging using a snapshot.

alex: Running backfill + reapply on prod now. I'll watch logs.

support-bot: job_7784 started...

support-bot: job_7784 result: 1 customer credited (acme-corp), amt=14 days trial, status=success.

zach: Backfill completed: 42 codes updated (per_customer_limit NULL), changed only where created_via='bulk_import' and created_at >= '2026-03-01'.

support-bot: queued reapply batch job_7785 for other affected customers (41 jobs).

sam: Monitoring: error rate for /v1/promos/apply dropped to baseline. No more limit_reached responses for those codes in last 15m.

marie: Customer comms: I'll send a short templated note, confirming the bug and that we've applied credits.

alex: Follow-up items:
- Add validation in bulk import UI to show explicit "unlimited" rather than blank
- Add import integration tests for blank fields
- Run audit to find other false-zero fields (global redemption, start offsets)

marie: I'm closing CS-1923 after final confirmation from accounts. Postmortem scheduled tomorrow 10:30.

zach: Postmortem note: root cause = CSV import blank -> 0 coercion (per_customer_limit). Impact = users could not redeem though code active. Fix = import loader change + backfill + reapply.

marie: Thanks all, please add any more notes in the postmortem doc. :thumbsup:
